literal_meaning: আঘাত করে দেওয়া (to strike or beat and give)
example_sentences_in_bangla: ভাইয়ের সঞ্চয় মেরে দিয়ে সে পালিয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has embezzled the company's money.
He stole his brother's savings and ran away.
note: This idiom is widely used in informal Bengali speech to describe dishonest appropriation of money or property.
